description: This file defines the BaseSymfonyController class, which extends Symfony's AbstractController and provides methods for rendering templates using Foil and Twig, managing context variables, and database caching and replica methods.

classes.name: BaseSymfonyController
classes.description: A base controller class extending Symfony's AbstractController, providing template rendering via Foil and Twig, context variable management, and database caching methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, setting up foil and twig renderers, and obtaining the service container.

methods.name: renderFoilTemplate
methods.description: Renders a template using the Foil engine with given parameters and returns a Response object.

methods.name: renderTwigTemplate
methods.description: Renders a template using the Twig engine with given parameters and returns a Response object.

methods.name: getRenderedResponse
methods.description: Helper method to render content with a specified engine and produce a Response object with headers and status.

methods.name: contextVars
methods.description: Provides a way to add context variables to views, either to a specific view path or globally.

methods.name: dbReplica
methods.description: Switches between primary and replica database connections.
